description: Records a jurisdictional or property-rights challenge against a parcel held in the etzhayyim Land Trust. The land donation is constitutionally inalienable per ADR-2605192245 — the challenge does NOT unwind the donation, regardless of outcome. This record exists for transparent documentation per ADR-2605192315 (Transparent Religious Force). Resolution requires Council Seat 5 (Stewardship/Land) + Seat 3 (Legal/Ethics) deliberation; Council attestation ≥3-of-5 multisig post-bootstrap.

landDonationRef.description: AT URI of the `com.etzhayyim.give.land.donation` record being challenged.

challengerCategory.description: Who is challenging. Single value, lowercase, hyphenated.

challengerJurisdiction.description: State / national / international jurisdiction identifier (e.g., 'JP', 'US-CA', 'EU', 'ICC'). Free-form to accommodate multi-jurisdictional reality.

claimSummary.description: Markdown summary of the claim against the parcel. Public — no encryption (transparent per ADR-2605192315).

evidenceCids.description: IPFS CIDs of evidence documents (court filings, claim documents, photos, surveys). May include both challenger-submitted and religious-corp-counter evidence.

councilDeliberationRef.description: Optional AT URI of the `com.etzhayyim.governance.proposal` record where Council deliberated the challenge.

resolutionStatus.description: Current resolution state. Single value, lowercase, hyphenated.

resolutionNarrative.description: Markdown narrative of the resolution. Required when resolutionStatus is non-filed/deliberating. Note: 'resolved-stewardship-amended' indicates the challenge prompted a stewardship-roster change via `com.etzhayyim.give.land.stewardSuccession` — the on-chain NFT remains in the Trust.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the challenge was first recorded.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent resolutionStatus / resolutionNarrative update.
